bounded_next_acquisition.status: plan_only; not executed; no automatic retry
bounded_next_acquisition.procedure: When official access is restored, explicitly acquire just these three male scouts to a new external directory; record byte hashes and receipts before adopting. Confirm orientation/side and actual arm extent, then separately plan a small contiguous elbow block. Stop if source identity or geometry differs.

observability.limits: First test actual visible contrast, separation and continuity in right-arm pixels. Fat may be separable macroscopically, but subcutaneous/intermuscular boundaries and fat pads remain unverified.
Distinct whiteness does not identify a named structure. Require traceable anatomical course, visible interfaces and adjacent sections; retain ambiguity, partial volume or not-resolvable status.
Inspect actual joint-level slices; distinguish layer from bone and joint space. XY improvement from film scans does not repair missing detail along 1 mm section intervals.

observability.assessment: cannot derive measurement from nominal resolution alone
observability.limits: An enthesis material footprint, fibre field or insertion mechanics requires independent evidence beyond a coarse tissue class.
